card_lines: Print day: Royal Sampler only comes off by clearing samples, so it waits for print day. Pulse uses statue week; Gold Relic is at 30 of 100 days.
Griffy before print day: book talents first, and the Royal Sampler EXP hit is smaller than it looks.
Prayer upgrades you can buy without eating into your soul reserve: Jawbreaker 0/50, Zerg Rushogen, Ruck Sack, Big Brain, Fibers of.
Careful: Dune Soul is close to a greenstack, buying Jawbreaker spends some of it.
Set each character's prayers to what they're doing today, the cards show each one.

Autiszemo: Prayers on: Skilled Dimwit, The Royal Sampler, Shiny Snitch.
Midas Minded / Big Brain Time: drop rate / class EXP when you overkill the map (curse raises mob HP).
Take off Shiny Snitch, it only helps while trapping and it lowers shiny chance otherwise.
Leave Royal Sampler on until print day.
